mapper.select:
select t.rown, t.id, t.deviceCode, t.deviceName, t.bindFlag, CASE WHEN t.bindFlag =1 THEN '' else t.iotName END iotDeviceName, CASE WHEN t.bindFlag =1 THEN '' else t.iotModelCode END iotDeviceCode from ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER ( ) AS rown, t3.id, t2.device_code AS deviceCode, ( case when length(IFNULL(ten.device_name, '')) = 0 then t2.device_name else ten.device_name end ) AS deviceName, case when (select count(*) from vm_order_sensor_devices where ord_status IN ( 0, 1, 2 ) and device_code =t3.iot_device_code and industry_code = t1.industry_code and tenant_id = t1.tenant_id) =0 THEN '1' else IFNULL(t3.bind_flag,1) end bindFlag, t4.device_name iotName, t4.device_code iotModelCode FROM vm_order_devices t1 LEFT JOIN vm_device_info_t t2 ON t1.device_code = t2.device_code and t2.delete_flag='0' LEFT JOIN vm_device_iot_rel_t t3 ON t1.device_code = t3.device_code and t3.delete_flag='0' and t3.industry_code = t1.industry_code and t3.tenant_id = t1.tenant_id LEFT JOIN vm_iot_device_t t4 ON t4.device_code = t3.iot_device_code and t4.delete_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_channel_rel_t ten on t1.device_code = ten.device_code and ten.tenant_id = t1.tenant_id and ten.industry_code = t1.industry_code and ten.delete_flag='0' WHERE t1.delete_flag = '0' AND t1.ord_status IN ( 0, 1, 2 )
AND t1.device_code = #{param.deviceCode}
AND ( case when length(IFNULL(ten.device_name, '')) = 0 then t2.device_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.deviceName},'%') else ten.device_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.deviceName},'%') end )
AND t3.bind_flag = '0'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vm_device_iot_rel_t WHERE device_code = t1.device_code and delete_flag = '0' and bind_flag ='0' and industry_code = t1.industry_code and tenant_id = t1.tenant_id )
AND t4.device_code = #{param.iotDeviceCode} and t3.bind_flag != '1'
and t4.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{param.iotDeviceName}, '%') and t3.bind_flag != '1'
${param.dataScope} GROUP BY t1.device_code ) t
select count(*) from vm_order_sensor_devices t where t.device_code = #{param.iotDeviceCode} and t.delete_flag = '0' and ord_status in (0,1,2)
mapper.update: update vm_device_iot_rel_t t set t.bind_flag = '1' set t.delete_flag = '1' where t.device_code = #{param.deviceCode} and t.iot_device_code = #{param.iotDeviceCode} and t.delete_flag = '0' and t.bind_flag = '0'
